title: FABULA: Retrieval-Augmented Narrative Construction for Intelligence Reports
summary: This community centers on the 2023 paper FABULA, which addresses the challenge of generating intelligence reports using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The work is authored by Priyanka Ranade and Anupam Joshi, focusing on narrative construction techniques to enhance report generation. It is cited within a broader context of recent advancements in large language models and retrieval-augmented language modeling.
key_findings: FABULA is a 2023 paper specifically dedicated to intelligence report generation using Retrieval-Augmented Narrative Construction.
The paper is authored by Priyanka Ranade and Anupam Joshi.
The work is situated among other recent research in the field, such as FoodGPT (2023) and Supportiveness-based Knowledge Rewriting (2024).
The citation context includes foundational works like T5 (2020) and NAACL-HLT 2021 proceedings, indicating its relevance to the broader NLP and LLM landscape.
